# dsh-store

The **catalog** behind the DSH plugin stores: a Python pipeline that discovers, verifies and
publish

lugin list for DeepSeek Harness,
plus a static browsing site and two machine-readable index sources.

| Site | https://qianyumeng0228.github.io/dsh-store/ |
| Index source (recommended) | `https://qiany

umeng0228.github.io/dsh-store/index-installable.json` |
| Full index (includes not-yet-installable r

ows) | `https://qianyumeng0228.github.io/dsh-store/index.json` |
| Site data (what the page loads) |

`https://qianyumeng0228.github.io/dsh-store/data/plugins.json` |

eng0228/dsh-plug-store |

Nothing needs to be run by hand: every push and a daily 03:17 UTC schedule re-run
seed → discovery →
verification → build → Pages deploy.
## Current numbers
Measured from the live `data/plugins.json` on 2026-11-04:

| Catalogued plugins | 29,593 |
| One-click installable | 14,344 (npm 10,598 sources / git remainder

source kept in `descEn`) |
| Coverage of every other public DSH index | 92–96% of each, and a super

n `descEn`) |
| Coverage of every other public DSH index | 92–96% of each, and a superset in total |

The last row is the point of this repo: it merges the ecosystem's independent registries instead
of
copying one of them.
## How an entry earns its place

An entry is listed only when the pipeline finds **evidence in the repository itself** — a
`package.j

son` carrying a `dsh` field, a `dsh.bundle` declaration, or a dependency on
`@deepseek-ai/dsh*`. Nam

es and topics are hints, never the criterion, so plugins that do not start
with `dsh-` are included
and mislabelled ones are not.
Discovery channels, all automated:
| Channel | What it contributes |

| `dsh.works` seed | the largest single registry, refreshed daily |
| `awesome-dsh-plugin.com` | cur

ated registry + icon map |
| `dshopen.org` | curated registry + icon map |
| GitHub topic scan | `to

pic:dsh-plugin`, `topic:deepseek-harness`, `topic:dsh` |
| npm keyword crawl | `keywords:dsh-plugin`

, `keywords:deepseek-harness` + manifest verification |
| External index mirrors | other marketplace

s' published `index.json` files, kept as *candidates* |
| GitHub code search | fallback for reposito
ries that carry the manifest signature but no topic |

External indexes are never trusted directly: their entries land as `status='pending'` candidates
and

are promoted only after `package.json` verification. That is why the catalog can claim 92–96%
cover
age of them without inheriting their dead links.

`GITHUB_TOKEN` matters: without it the API budget is 60 requests/hour and each stage degrades to
a s

mall batch. `store.db` is the only carrier of incremental progress — in CI it is persisted by
`actio

ns/cache` under a **per-run key** with `restore-keys`, because a cache key cannot be
overwritten onc

e it exists (a fixed key silently froze the database at its first-day snapshot and
threw away every

## Submitting a plugin

Use the site's **Submit** tab, which builds a pre-filled issue for this repository, or open one
dire
ctly: https://github.com/qianyumeng0228/dsh-store/issues/new

Inclusion requires a reachable repository whose `package.json` carries DSH evidence, plus either a
p

ublished npm package or a git source the host can install. Entries are re-checked daily; dead,
stole

n or mislabelled ones are dropped. Adding `topic:dsh-plugin` to your repository gets it
picked up wi

es are dropped. Adding `topic:dsh-plugin` to your repository gets it
picked up without a submission.
## Known limits

- **Git long tail.** A git-sourced entry needs a resolved commit before it becomes installable.
~17,

000 entries are still queued and each run fills about 2,000 (API budget and runtime bound),
so insta

llable coverage keeps climbing for days rather than instantly.
- **"Has update" is catalog-relative.

** This site cannot see your installed versions; it compares
against what it last recorded. Per-mach

ine update decisions belong to the host plugin.
- **Machine translation is machine translation.** Ch

inese descriptions are auto-generated from
English ones and kept beside the source (`desc` / `descEn

`) so the original is never lost.
- **The scheduled build is not guaranteed on time.** The 03:17 UTC

cron has been observed starting
hours late, or skipping a day. Use `workflow_dispatch` if you need

a deterministic refresh.
- **`index.json` is committed** so jsDelivr can mirror it, which grows the

repository by ~11 MB per
meaningful change; if that ever hurts, it should move to release assets or

an orphan branch.
- Listing is not endorsement: every entry is third-party code.
